slides.title: Wonderful Water
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 1 English, Unit 8: Wonderful Water. In this unit you will learn about water — where it comes from, where we find it, and all the ways we use it every day. You will meet rainy and sunny weather, animals that live in water, and the big idea that water is a gift we should never waste. Say the words out loud — this is about confident English and being thankful for water, not perfect spelling. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Say why plants, animals, and people all need water.
Name places where we find water (rain, river, sea, well).
Say how we use water: “I use water to drink / wash / cook.”
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to say why plants, animals, and people all need water. You will also name places where we find water (rain, river, sea, well). You will also say how we use water: “I use water to drink / wash / cook.” Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: water, rain, drop, wet, dry, clean. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes The Well in the Village and Talk about Wonderful Water. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Say what you use water for
bullets: Think of one way you use water every day. After 'to', use the plain action word.
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Say what you use water for. Think of one way you use water every day. After 'to', use the plain action word. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 - Listen and point. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
